title: YouTuber held in UAPA case, sent to prison in Andhra Pradesh
description: Controversial YouTuber Bachalakuri Joseph alias Raavan was arrested and sent to 14-day judicial custody under the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act (UAPA) and other sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) for allegedly promoting Maoist ideology and encouraging armed rebellion, a senior officer in Andhra Pradesh police said
